name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta Province of Argentina. The Diablillos deposit hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold, making it one of the largest undeveloped silver deposits in the Americas. The company is advancing toward a development decision after the project was formally approved under Argentina's Large Investment program in early 2026.
